description:
Team Myles O’Donoghue is delighted to present 9 Beechfield Heights. This well-presented 2 bedroom terraced house is ideally situated within this established and popular residential development. The property offers bright and well-proportioned accommodation throughout.

The accommodation briefly comprises: a spacious living room and kitchen with useful understairs storage. The property benefits from timber flooring throughout the ground floor, creating a warm and welcoming feel.

On the first floor, the accommodation continues with two generous double bedrooms, both featuring built in wardrobes, and a family bathroom. The bathroom is fitted with a WC, wash hand basin and a white incorporated bath with shower attachment.

The property also benefits from a private rear garden, providing an excellent outdoor space with further potential for the new owner to personalise and enjoy.

Beechfield Heights is conveniently located with a host of local amenities within easy reach, including shops, schools, childcare facilities, restaurants and a wide range of recreational amenities. The nearby Blanchardstown Centre offers an extensive selection of shops, restaurants, cafés, cinema and leisure facilities.

The area is well serviced by public transport with a number of Dublin Bus routes providing access to Dublin City Centre and surrounding areas. Coolmine and Clonsilla train stations are also within easy reach, providing convenient access to the city centre and beyond. The M50 motorway is readily accessible, providing an excellent road network to North and South Dublin, Dublin Airport and the wider commuter belt.

9 Beechfield Heights is presented in good condition throughout and offers well-proportioned accommodation in a convenient and established residential setting. Early viewing is highly recommended to appreciate all that this property has to offer.
